text: Complete your preparation sheets as follows. The amounts you cook should be sufficient for two
or three people. You may use recipe books.
At the end of the planning session, give your question paper, preparation sheets and any notes
you have made to the Supervisor. You may not take these away from the planning session. You
may not bring any additional notes to the practical test.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Make a cake using the whisking method and make a dish using potatoes.
2 (a) Prepare, cook and serve three skilful dishes, each showing the use of a different method of
cooking from the following list:
deep-fat frying, steaming, stewing, grilling.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Make a sweet dish to be served cold and make a batch of scones.
3 Prepare, cook and serve five skilful dishes to serve at a party for your teenage friends. Three of
the dishes must be savoury and one of the dishes must be a cake made by the creaming method.

text: At the beginning of the practical test, you will be given back your question paper, preparation
sheets and any notes you made during the planning session.
For the purposes of the Practical Test, a balanced main meal must consist of:
TWO skilful dishes plus a minimum of TWO suitable accompaniments.
1 (a) Prepare, cook and serve a balanced main meal for two relatives who have type 2 diabetes.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Prepare, cook and serve a balanced main meal for two manual workers.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Make one savoury dish and one sweet dish that the workers could take for a cold packed
meal the next day.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Prepare, cook and serve three skilful dishes that are suitable for vegetarians.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Make a sweet dish using chocolate and make a batch of scones.

text: Prepare, cook and serve five skilful dishes, each showing the use of a different main ingredient
a leafy vegetable, cheese, citrus fruit, nuts, red meat, soya, wholewheat flour.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Prepare, cook and serve three skilful dishes, each showing the use of a different piece of
equipment from the following list:
food processor, microwave, piping bag, saucepan, steamer.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Make a dish using yeast and make a batch of biscuits.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Prepare, cook and serve a balanced main meal that is rich in vitamin A.

Make a dish using flaky pastry and make a dish using the melting method.
